cases.name: Donna Ann Barrett Morrow
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE W/ FUGITIVE SUSPECT; CONVICTION
cases.narrative:
In 9/2003, a tip led police to Donna's body, wrapped in plastic and carpet and buried in a hole 10-feet deep, was found on the property the Morrows once owned in Los Gatos, CA. Her wedding ring was missing; however, it was later found in Joe's mother's possession. 

Investigators theorized he strangled her.

cases.name: Kathleen Anne Hughes Anderson
cases.narrative: Stabbed in the head with a sharp instrument.
